name: Low Tide
description: Tape with a memory and a lifespan: lo-fi that moves in time with the song. The audio runs through a tape loop dubbed again on every pass (each generation duller, hissier, softer and wobblier; Fresh snaps it back), a Wear macro swept by a tempo-synced Tide cycle, gentle tape accidents on the beat (dropouts, motor drag, slips, crinkle, channel cuts), an old-sampler resample crunch that follows the record pitch, print-through, azimuth drift, breathing hiss, wow and flutter.
author: Groundswell
